source_note: Observed closures for Fedwire and FedACH, derived from the 2026-2030 Federal Reserve Banks holiday table transcribed on 2026-10-21. A holiday that falls on Saturday is not moved to Friday: the Fed is open that Friday. A holiday that falls on Sunday is observed the following Monday. Weekends are closed even when they are not listed here.
saturday_rule_sentence: For holidays falling on Saturday, Federal Reserve Banks and Branches will be open the preceding Friday.
sunday_rule_sentence: For holidays falling on Sunday, Federal Reserve Banks and Branches will be closed the following Monday.
